svg.title: STORY thesis workflow — sixteen skills in five bands, what each one writes, and how the loops close
svg.text: Sixteen skills in five bands · fifteen in order and one that reads across them · what each one writes · how the loops close
An existing thesis or Overleaf export wired in
Evidence imported read-only, a fingerprint per file
Where the thesis stands, and the one next action
Chapters mapped to questions, claims, evidence
Verified bib records and checkable reading notes
Tables built from evidence, never typed
Every figure: a purpose, a source, a rendered PDF
Voice and flow polished — never a fact or a number
Every number and contribution traced, or flagged
A degree-level mock exam of the built thesis
Every point given a disposition; promises tracked
An applicable defense: narrative, deck, questions
CORRECTIONS OPEN A NEW MILESTONE · FEEDBACK IS NEVER EDITED
An outcome that requires corrections opens a correction milestone whose parent is the
milestone examined; its open promises run back through the drafting loop to be closed.
Every gate checked; bundle packed, record frozen
audits older than the last edit
Every number traces to a fingerprinted mates/ entry
or is written \todo{…}. Fix it at the source, re-import.
mates/ is never edited in place · conventions §2
THE CLAIM LEDGER IS THE HUB
Every claim names its contribution, evidence, and
status in notes/claims.md: proposed → drafted → verified.
updated in the same change · conventions §3
THE DEGREE LEVEL IS CONFIRMED, NEVER INFERRED
contributions and milestones apply: master’s or doctoral.
reads every stage · run it any time
† runs only when you name it
bands alternate direction — follow the arrows
